description: Defines utility classes for random access iterator proxies and composite random access iterators, used in the ATen native library for tensor operations.

classes.name: operator_brackets_proxy
classes.description: Proxy class to safely implement operator[] for iterators, returning references or assigning values.

classes.name: references_holder
classes.description: Holds references or values, providing conversion operators and data access for iterator reference types.

classes.name: CompositeRandomAccessor
classes.description: A simplified random access iterator over two underlying iterators, supporting pointer-like and arithmetic operations.

methods.name: operator_brackets_proxy
methods.description: Constructs the proxy with an accessor.

methods.name: operator reference()
methods.description: Returns a reference to the element pointed to by the accessor.

methods.name: operator*()
methods.description: Dereferences the accessor to get the element.

methods.name: operator=(value_type const& val)
methods.description: Assigns a value to the element pointed to by the accessor.

methods.name: references_holder
methods.description: Constructs with references, provides conversion to references and values, and access to internal refs.

methods.name: operator=(values vals)
methods.description: Assigns new values to the internal references.

methods.name: data()
methods.description: Provides access to the internal references.

methods.name: CompositeRandomAccessor
methods.description: Constructs with key and value accessors, supports dereferencing, pointer access, indexing, increment/decrement, arithmetic, and comparison operators.
